# RMA of Michigan

Site: https://www.rmami.com
Entity: Reproductive Medicine Associates of Michigan (RMA of Michigan)
Type: Fertility clinic and reproductive medicine practice
Primary location: 130 Town Center Drive, Suite 106, Troy, MI 48084
Phone: (248) 619-3100
Email: rmapatientservices@rmami.com

Summary:
RMA of Michigan provides fertility care in Troy, Michigan, including IVF, IUI, egg freezing, fertility testing, PGT-A, donor egg IVF, egg donation, LGBTQ+ family building, gestational carrier coordination, ovulation induction, and fertility surgery.
